definitions.explanation: An angle that is not a right angle — a slanted angle. Used in geometry, and in machining or carpentry for a cut or join made on the slant.

examples.english: To cut the board at an oblique angle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二枚|にまい}→二枚：30347_nimai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{板|いた}→板：01792_ita⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{斜角|しゃかく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{接合|せつごう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To join the two boards at an angle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鏡|かがみ}→鏡：02190_kagami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{斜角|しゃかく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{付|つ}ける→取り付ける：06797_toritsukeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{反射|はんしゃ}→反射：08390_hansha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: Mounting the mirror at an oblique angle changes the reflection of the light.

notes:
An angle other than a right angle — a slanted or bevelled angle. It appears in geometry and, practically, in cutting or joining materials on the slant.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {斜角|しゃかく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to cut at an angle
- {斜角|しゃかく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to put a bevel on something

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{直角|ちょっかく}→直角：05444_chokkaku⟧: right angle — exactly 90 degrees
- ⟦{鋭角|えいかく}→鋭角：05554_eikaku⟧ / ⟦{鈍角|どんかく}→鈍角：05555_donkaku⟧: acute angle / obtuse angle — angles smaller or larger than a right angle
